pages.text: Your progression tracker, guide, and reward system. The quest book is not optional — it is how you advance tiers.$(br2)$(bold)Opening:$() Default key $(bold)P$() or click the shield icon in the HUD.$(br2)$(bold)Nine chapters:$() Welcome · $(t1)Tier 1$()–$(t4)4$() · Crucible · Community · Prestige · Classes & Skills.$(br2)$(bold)Five paths per tier:$() Grinding, Magic, Combat, Exploration, Engineering. Complete any one to advance.$(br2)$(bold)Skill points:$() Every quest path rewards skill points. Completing all 5 paths in a tier gives approximately 10 extra points beyond the minimum. This is the primary reason to complete non-required paths.$(br2)$(bold)Loot boxes:$() Non-required path completions reward loot boxes. The Prestige chapter gives endgame rewards.
